title: TANDEM: Temporal-Aware Neural Detection for Multimodal Hate Speech
measurement_description: The paper measures the ability of multimodal models to identify specific groups, including religious groups (Jews, Muslims, Christians), as the targets of hate speech in video content.
findings: The paper's proposed framework, TANDEM, significantly improves structured prediction, including the identification of hate speech targets. While not isolating findings specifically for religious groups, it achieves a 0.73 F1 score for general target identification on the HateMM dataset, a task which includes recognizing religious groups like Jews, Muslims, and Christians as targets.
